interpretation: The frozen raw source-fused probabilities are miscalibrated on target PP records in opposite directions. The signed score decomposition locates the adverse decision shifts; it does not identify physical causes or counterfactual control costs.
interpretation_limits: Probability bias and reliability are calibration diagnostics; Brier is overall probability squared error, not pure calibration error. Old endpoint edge-count MAE uses a different decoder and observation unit. Bins/context totals pool repeated snapshot-queries, equal-seed means use nonempty seeds, and changed-action contexts are selected diagnostics on reused development records. No physical cause or actual changed-action traffic cost was identified.
next_step: Freeze the identified contexts and query horizons; use existing pre-decision signal/queue information to inspect whether omitted state explains source/local arrival differences before fitting or tuning another model.
nominal_service_score_unit: vehicle-second (one-second nominal protected service queries), not realized discharge
